answer: Proposal for saffron provenance: a cadastral registry admits one key per surveyed meadow-edge growing plot per 90-day season. Independent labs sign the pigment spectrum of that plot’s saffron; auditors sample plants on site and validators compare assay, coordinates and registry ID. A farm shares one model and rents land, but each clone needs a different productive plot for 90 days; financing cannot reuse an occupied plot. If a plot ID repeats, validators pay zero; if a signed assay conflicts with a field sample, they burn that key’s escrow. Trusted surveyors and labs are required.
